nodes.label: Initial user task
nodes.initial_task: Investigate why February net revenue differs from January. Reconcile the supplied orders, refunds and product data using the definitions in data_dictionary.md. Produce a reproducible analysis and report.md with the monthly totals, the main drivers, and any data quality issues. Do not silently count duplicate events or include orders that are not paid.

Use the read tool — not shell commands like cat — to inspect text files. Use offset and limit to continue reading large files.

Track every background job id you start. function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

function.description: Request cancellation of a running background job.

function.description: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

wait.description: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running. Defaults to false.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in milliseconds with wait: true. Defaults to and is capped by configuration.

function.name: list_agents
function.description: List subagents you started, with their ids, labels, and status. running means it is working; inactive means it is not currently working. You will be notified when a subagent finishes; there is no need to keep checking its status. Use send_message to continue the conversation.

function.description: Send a message to an agent. A working agent receives it at its next step; an idle agent starts a new turn with it. Returns delivery confirmation, not the agent's answer.

agent_id.description: The agent id of your direct continuable child, or your direct parent when you are a resident continuable child.

message.description: The message to deliver to the agent.

name.description: The exact skill name from the available skills list.

function.name: subagent
function.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

function.description: Delegate a task to a subagent that inherits this conversation: a child agent seeded with all completed turns so far (it does not see the current in-flight turn). Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

cwd.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The task for the subagent. It already sees this conversation's completed turns, so build on them freely and state only what is new.

function.description: Record and update a task list to plan multi-step work and show progress; skip it for trivial single-step tasks. Add one todo per concrete step before you start. function.name: update_goal
function.description: Update the current goal.

revision.description: Exact positive revision returned by get_goal.

action.description: edit, pause, and resume require a direct top-level human request. complete and blocked are also allowed during an automatic continuation of this goal; blocked is rejected before the configured minimum round count.

objective.description: Replacement objective; valid only with action edit.

max_goal_rounds.description: Replacement cap; valid only with action edit.

blocked_reason.description: Required only with action blocked: the concrete condition that persisted across rounds and blocks progress.

function.description: Fetch the content of a specific HTTP(S) URL and return it decoded to text.

function.name: workflow
function.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

  * Orders may contain exact repeated order_id delivery events; count each
    order_id once.
  * Only status=paid contributes quantity * products.unit_price.
  * Refunds are dollar amounts; deduplicate by refund_id and attribute each
    refund to its original paid order month.
  * Net revenue = paid gross revenue - unique refunds.
  * Product mix uses paid orders only.

Run:  python3 analyze.py

import csv
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
MONTHS = ("2026-01", "2026-02")


def load_csv(name):
    with open(BASE / name, newline="") as f:
        return list(csv.DictReader(f))


def main():
    products = {r["product_id"]: r for r in load_csv("products.csv")}
    order_rows = load_csv("orders.csv")
    refund_rows = load_csv("refunds.csv")

    dq = []  # data quality findings

    # ---- Orders: deduplicate by order_id --------------------------------
    seen = {}
    dup_orders = []
    for i, row in enumerate(order_rows, start=2):  # line numbers incl. header
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid in seen:
            first = seen[oid]
            if first == row:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "exact duplicate row", i))
            else:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "CONFLICTING duplicate row", i))
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: order {oid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i}): {first[1]} vs {row}")
        else:
            seen[oid] = (i, row)

    orders = [row for _, row in seen.values()]
    if dup_orders:
        dq.append("Duplicate order rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "order_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{oid} (line {ln})" for oid, kind, ln in dup_orders))

    # ---- Refunds: deduplicate by refund_id ------------------------------
    seen_r = {}
    dup_refunds = []
    for i, row in enumerate(refund_rows, start=2):
        rid = row["refund_id"]
        if rid in seen_r:
            first = seen_r[rid]
            if first[1] == row:
                dup_refunds.append((rid, i))
            else:
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: refund {rid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i})")
        else:
            seen_r[rid] = (i, row)

    refunds = [row for _, row in seen_r.values()]
    if dup_refunds:
        dq.append("Duplicate refund rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "refund_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{rid} (line {ln})" for rid, ln in dup_refunds))

    # ---- Validation ------------------------------------------------------
    paid_orders = []
    for row in orders:
        pid = row["product_id"]
        if pid not in products:
            dq.append(f"Order {row['order_id']} references unknown product {pid}")
            continue
        if row["status"] != "paid":
            continue
        paid_orders.append(row)

    paid_ids = {r["order_id"] for r in paid_orders}
    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid not in {r["order_id"] for r in orders}:
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references unknown order {oid}")
        elif oid not in paid_ids:
            orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid)
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references non-paid order {oid} "
                      f"(status={orig['status']}); excluded from net revenue")

    # ---- Monthly aggregation --------------------------------------------
    gross = defaultdict(float)
    refund_total = defaultdict(float)
    mix = defaultdict(Counter)          # month -> product -> units
    mix_rev = defaultdict(Counter)      # month -> product -> revenue
    paid_count = Counter()
    cancelled_count = Counter()

    for row in orders:
        month = row["paid_date"][:7]
        if row["status"] == "paid":
            paid_count[month] += 1
            price = float(products[row["product_id"]]["unit_price"])
            qty = int(row["quantity"])
            rev = qty * price
            gross[month] += rev
            mix[month][row["product_id"]] += qty
            mix_rev[month][row["product_id"]] += rev
        else:
            cancelled_count[month] += 1

    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]

"""Reproducible reconciliation of January vs February net revenue.

    refund to its original paid order month.
  * Net revenue = paid gross revenue - unique refunds.
  * Product mix uses paid orders only.

Run:  python3 analyze.py
"""

import csv
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
MONTHS = ("2026-01", "2026-02")


def load_csv(name):
    with open(BASE / name, newline="") as f:
        return list(csv.DictReader(f))


def main():
    products = {r["product_id"]: r for r in load_csv("products.csv")}
    order_rows = load_csv("orders.csv")
    refund_rows = load_csv("refunds.csv")

    dq = []  # data quality findings

    # ---- Orders: deduplicate by order_id --------------------------------
    seen = {}
    dup_orders = []
    for i, row in enumerate(order_rows, start=2):  # line numbers incl. header
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid in seen:
            first = seen[oid]
            if first == row:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "exact duplicate row", i))
            else:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "CONFLICTING duplicate row", i))
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: order {oid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i}): {first[1]} vs {row}")
        else:
            seen[oid] = (i, row)

    orders = [row for _, row in seen.values()]
    if dup_orders:
        dq.append("Duplicate order rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "order_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{oid} (line {ln})" for oid, kind, ln in dup_orders))

    # ---- Refunds: deduplicate by refund_id ------------------------------
    seen_r = {}
    dup_refunds = []
    for i, row in enumerate(refund_rows, start=2):
        rid = row["refund_id"]
        if rid in seen_r:
            first = seen_r[rid]
            if first[1] == row:
                dup_refunds.append((rid, i))
            else:
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: refund {rid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i})")
        else:
            seen_r[rid] = (i, row)

    refunds = [row for _, row in seen_r.values()]
    if dup_refunds:
        dq.append("Duplicate refund rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "refund_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{rid} (line {ln})" for rid, ln in dup_refunds))

    # ---- Validation ------------------------------------------------------
    paid_orders = []
    for row in orders:
        pid = row["product_id"]
        if pid not in products:
            dq.append(f"Order {row['order_id']} references unknown product {pid}")
            continue
        if row["status"] != "paid":
            continue
        paid_orders.append(row)

    paid_ids = {r["order_id"] for r in paid_orders}
    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid not in {r["order_id"] for r in orders}:
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references unknown order {oid}")
        elif oid not in paid_ids:
            orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid)
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references non-paid order {oid} "
                      f"(status={orig['status']}); excluded from net revenue")

    # ---- Monthly aggregation --------------------------------------------
    gross = defaultdict(float)
    refund_total = defaultdict(float)
    mix = defaultdict(Counter)          # month -> product -> units
    mix_rev = defaultdict(Counter)      # month -> product -> revenue
    paid_count = Counter()
    cancelled_count = Counter()

    for row in orders:
        month = row["paid_date"][:7]
        if row["status"] == "paid":
            paid_count[month] += 1
            price = float(products[row["product_id"]]["unit_price"])
            qty = int(row["quantity"])
            rev = qty * price
            gross[month] += rev
            mix[month][row["product_id"]] += qty
            mix_rev[month][row["product_id"]] += rev
        else:
            cancelled_count[month] += 1

    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        orig = next((r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid), None)
        if orig is not None and orig["status"] == "paid":
            refund_total[orig["paid_date"][:7]] += float(row["amount"])

    # ---- Report ----------------------------------------------------------
    print("=" * 62)
    print("MONTHLY REVENUE RECONCILIATION (USD)")
    print("=" * 62)
    header = f"{'month':<10}{'paid':>6}{'cancelled':>10}{'gross':>10}{'refunds':>10}{'net':>10}"
    print(header)
    print("-" * len(header))
    net = {}
    for m in MONTHS:
        net[m] = gross[m] - refund_total[m]
        print(f"{m:<10}{paid_count[m]:>6}{cancelled_count[m]:>10}"
              f"{gross[m]:>10.2f}{refund_total[m]:>10.2f}{net[m]:>10.2f}")

    jan, feb = MONTHS
    print("-" * len(header))
    print(f"Change Jan -> Feb: gross {gross[feb] - gross[jan]:+.2f} "
          f"({(gross[feb] - gross[jan]) / gross[jan] * 100:+.1f}%), "
          f"refunds {refund_total[feb] - refund_total[jan]:+.2f}, "
          f"net {net[feb] - net[jan]:+.2f} "
          f"({(net[feb] - net[jan]) / net[jan] * 100:+.1f}%)")

    print()
    print("PRODUCT MIX (paid orders only)")
    print("-" * len(header))
    all_pids = sorted(products)
    print(f"{'product':<10}{'price':>8}" + "".join(f"{m + ' qty':>12}" for m in MONTHS)
          + "".join(f"{m + ' rev':>12}" for m in MONTHS))
    for pid in all_pids:
        line = f"{pid:<10}{float(products[pid]['unit_price']):>8.0f}"
        for m in MONTHS:
            line += f"{mix[m][pid]:>12}"
        for m in MONTHS:
            line += f"{mix_rev[m][pid]:>12.2f}"
        print(line)

    print()
    print("REFUND DETAIL (deduplicated, attributed to paid order month)")
    print("-" * len(header))
    for row in sorted(refunds, key=lambda r: r["refund_id"]):
        orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == row["order_id"])
        print(f"{row['refund_id']:<6} order {row['order_id']:<7} "
              f"month {orig['paid_date'][:7]}  amount {float(row['amount']):>8.2f}")

    print()
    print("DATA QUALITY FINDINGS")
    print("-" * len(header))
    if dq:
        for i, d in enumerate(dq, 1):
            print(f"{i}. {d}")
    else:
        print("None.")

    # Machine-readable summary for the report
    summary = {
        "months": {
            m: {
                "paid_orders": paid_count[m],
                "cancelled_orders": cancelled_count[m],
                "gross_revenue": gross[m],
                "refunds": refund_total[m],

{"file_path":"/home/Liangyijia_Hu/dsh-natural-workspaces/natural-dag-20261029-v002/analysis/analyze.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reproducible reconciliation of January vs February net revenue.

Rules (from data_dictionary.md):
  * Amounts are USD.
  * Orders may contain exact repeated order_id delivery events; count each
    order_id once.
  * Only status=paid contributes quantity * products.unit_price.
  * Refunds are dollar amounts; deduplicate by refund_id and attribute each
    refund to its original paid order month.
  * Net revenue = paid gross revenue - unique refunds.
  * Product mix uses paid orders only.

Run:  python3 analyze.py
"""

import csv
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
MONTHS = ("2026-01", "2026-02")


def load_csv(name):
    with open(BASE / name, newline="") as f:
        return list(csv.DictReader(f))


def main():
    products = {r["product_id"]: r for r in load_csv("products.csv")}
    order_rows = load_csv("orders.csv")
    refund_rows = load_csv("refunds.csv")

    dq = []  # data quality findings

    # ---- Orders: deduplicate by order_id --------------------------------
    seen = {}
    dup_orders = []
    for i, row in enumerate(order_rows, start=2):  # line numbers incl. header
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid in seen:
            first = seen[oid]
            if first == row:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "exact duplicate row", i))
            else:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "CONFLICTING duplicate row", i))
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: order {oid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i}): {first[1]} vs {row}")
        else:
            seen[oid] = (i, row)

    orders = [row for _, row in seen.values()]
    if dup_orders:
        dq.append("Duplicate order rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "order_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{oid} (line {ln})" for oid, kind, ln in dup_orders))

    # ---- Refunds: deduplicate by refund_id ------------------------------
    seen_r = {}
    dup_refunds = []
    for i, row in enumerate(refund_rows, start=2):
        rid = row["refund_id"]
        if rid in seen_r:
            first = seen_r[rid]
            if first[1] == row:
                dup_refunds.append((rid, i))
            else:
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: refund {rid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i})")
        else:
            seen_r[rid] = (i, row)

    refunds = [row for _, row in seen_r.values()]
    if dup_refunds:
        dq.append("Duplicate refund rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "refund_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{rid} (line {ln})" for rid, ln in dup_refunds))

    # ---- Validation ------------------------------------------------------
    paid_orders = []
    for row in orders:
        pid = row["product_id"]
        if pid not in products:
            dq.append(f"Order {row['order_id']} references unknown product {pid}")
            continue
        if row["status"] != "paid":
            continue
        paid_orders.append(row)

    paid_ids = {r["order_id"] for r in paid_orders}
    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid not in {r["order_id"] for r in orders}:
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references unknown order {oid}")
        elif oid not in paid_ids:
            orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid)
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references non-paid order {oid} "
                      f"(status={orig['status']}); excluded from net revenue")

    # ---- Monthly aggregation --------------------------------------------
    gross = defaultdict(float)
    refund_total = defaultdict(float)
    mix = defaultdict(Counter)          # month -> product -> units
    mix_rev = defaultdict(Counter)      # month -> product -> revenue
    paid_count = Counter()
    cancelled_count = Counter()

    for row in orders:
        month = row["paid_date"][:7]
        if row["status"] == "paid":
            paid_count[month] += 1
            price = float(products[row["product_id"]]["unit_price"])
            qty = int(row["quantity"])
            rev = qty * price
            gross[month] += rev
            mix[month][row["product_id"]] += qty
            mix_rev[month][row["product_id"]] += rev
        else:
            cancelled_count[month] += 1

    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        orig = next((r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid), None)
        if orig is not None and orig["status"] == "paid":
            refund_total[orig["paid_date"][:7]] += float(row["amount"])

    # ---- Report ----------------------------------------------------------
    print("=" * 62)
    print("MONTHLY REVENUE RECONCILIATION (USD)")
    print("=" * 62)
    header = f"{'month':<10}{'paid':>6}{'cancelled':>10}{'gross':>10}{'refunds':>10}{'net':>10}"
    print(header)
    print("-" * len(header))
    net = {}
    for m in MONTHS:
        net[m] = gross[m] - refund_total[m]
        print(f"{m:<10}{paid_count[m]:>6}{cancelled_count[m]:>10}"
              f"{gross[m]:>10.2f}{refund_total[m]:>10.2f}{net[m]:>10.2f}")

    jan, feb = MONTHS
    print("-" * len(header))
    print(f"Change Jan -> Feb: gross {gross[feb] - gross[jan]:+.2f} "
          f"({(gross[feb] - gross[jan]) / gross[jan] * 100:+.1f}%), "
          f"refunds {refund_total[feb] - refund_total[jan]:+.2f}, "
          f"net {net[feb] - net[jan]:+.2f} "
          f"({(net[feb] - net[jan]) / net[jan] * 100:+.1f}%)")

    print()
    print("PRODUCT MIX (paid orders only)")
    print("-" * len(header))
    all_pids = sorted(products)
    print(f"{'product':<10}{'price':>8}" + "".join(f"{m + ' qty':>12}" for m in MONTHS)
          + "".join(f"{m + ' rev':>12}" for m in MONTHS))
    for pid in all_pids:
        line = f"{pid:<10}{float(products[pid]['unit_price']):>8.0f}"
        for m in MONTHS:
            line += f"{mix[m][pid]:>12}"
        for m in MONTHS:
            line += f"{mix_rev[m][pid]:>12.2f}"
        print(line)

    print()
    print("REFUND DETAIL (deduplicated, attributed to paid order month)")
    print("-" * len(header))
    for row in sorted(refunds, key=lambda r: r["refund_id"]):
        orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == row["order_id"])
        print(f"{row['refund_id']:<6} order {row['order_id']:<7} "
              f"month {orig['paid_date'][:7]}  amount {float(row['amount']):>8.2f}")

    print()
    print("DATA QUALITY FINDINGS")
    print("-" * len(header))
    if dq:
        for i, d in enumerate(dq, 1):
            print(f"{i}. {d}")
    else:
        print("None.")

    # Machine-readable summary for the report
    summary = {
        "months": {
            m: {
                "paid_orders": paid_count[m],
                "cancelled_orders": cancelled_count[m],
                "gross_revenue": gross[m],
                "refunds": refund_total[m],
                "net_revenue": net[m],
                "units_by_product": dict(mix[m]),
                "revenue_by_product": dict(mix_rev[m]),
            } for m in MONTHS
        },
        "data_quality": dq,
    }
    import json
    (BASE / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    print()
    print("Wrote summary.json")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
"}

{"file_path":"/home/Liangyijia_Hu/dsh-natural-workspaces/natural-dag-20261029-v002/analysis/analyze.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reproducible reconciliation of January vs February net revenue.

Rules (from data_dictionary.md):
  * Amounts are USD.
  * Orders may contain exact repeated order_id delivery events; count each
    order_id once.
  * Only status=paid contributes quantity * products.unit_price.
  * Refunds are dollar amounts; deduplicate by refund_id and attribute each
    refund to its original paid order month.
  * Net revenue = paid gross revenue - unique refunds.
  * Product mix uses paid orders only.

Run:  python3 analyze.py
"""

import csv
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
MONTHS = ("2026-01", "2026-02")


def load_csv(name):
    with open(BASE / name, newline="") as f:
        return list(csv.DictReader(f))


def main():
    products = {r["product_id"]: r for r in load_csv("products.csv")}
    order_rows = load_csv("orders.csv")
    refund_rows = load_csv("refunds.csv")

    dq = []  # data quality findings

    # ---- Orders: deduplicate by order_id --------------------------------
    seen = {}
    dup_orders = []
    for i, row in enumerate(order_rows, start=2):  # line numbers incl. header
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid in seen:
            first = seen[oid]
            if first == row:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "exact duplicate row", i))
            else:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "CONFLICTING duplicate row", i))
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: order {oid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i}): {first[1]} vs {row}")
        else:
            seen[oid] = (i, row)

    orders = [row for _, row in seen.values()]
    if dup_orders:
        dq.append("Duplicate order rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "order_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{oid} (line {ln})" for oid, kind, ln in dup_orders))

    # ---- Refunds: deduplicate by refund_id ------------------------------
    seen_r = {}
    dup_refunds = []
    for i, row in enumerate(refund_rows, start=2):
        rid = row["refund_id"]
        if rid in seen_r:
            first = seen_r[rid]
            if first[1] == row:
                dup_refunds.append((rid, i))
            else:
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: refund {rid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i})")
        else:
            seen_r[rid] = (i, row)

    refunds = [row for _, row in seen_r.values()]
    if dup_refunds:
        dq.append("Duplicate refund rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "refund_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{rid} (line {ln})" for rid, ln in dup_refunds))

    # ---- Validation ------------------------------------------------------
    paid_orders = []
    for row in orders:
        pid = row["product_id"]
        if pid not in products:
            dq.append(f"Order {row['order_id']} references unknown product {pid}")
            continue
        if row["status"] != "paid":
            continue
        paid_orders.append(row)

    paid_ids = {r["order_id"] for r in paid_orders}
    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid not in {r["order_id"] for r in orders}:
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references unknown order {oid}")
        elif oid not in paid_ids:
            orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid)
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references non-paid order {oid} "
                      f"(status={orig['status']}); excluded from net revenue")

    # ---- Monthly aggregation --------------------------------------------
    gross = defaultdict(float)
    refund_total = defaultdict(float)
    mix = defaultdict(Counter)          # month -> product -> units
    mix_rev = defaultdict(Counter)      # month -> product -> revenue
    paid_count = Counter()
    cancelled_count = Counter()

    for row in orders:
        month = row["paid_date"][:7]
        if row["status"] == "paid":
            paid_count[month] += 1
            price = float(products[row["product_id"]]["unit_price"])
            qty = int(row["quantity"])
            rev = qty * price
            gross[month] += rev
            mix[month][row["product_id"]] += qty
            mix_rev[month][row["product_id"]] += rev
        else:
            cancelled_count[month] += 1

    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        orig = next((r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid), None)
        if orig is not None and orig["status"] == "paid":
            refund_total[orig["paid_date"][:7]] += float(row["amount"])

    # ---- Report ----------------------------------------------------------
    print("=" * 62)
    print("MONTHLY REVENUE RECONCILIATION (USD)")
    print("=" * 62)
    header = f"{'month':<10}{'paid':>6}{'cancelled':>10}{'gross':>10}{'refunds':>10}{'net':>10}"
    print(header)
    print("-" * len(header))
    net = {}
    for m in MONTHS:
        net[m] = gross[m] - refund_total[m]
        print(f"{m:<10}{paid_count[m]:>6}{cancelled_count[m]:>10}"
              f"{gross[m]:>10.2f}{refund_total[m]:>10.2f}{net[m]:>10.2f}")

    jan, feb = MONTHS
    print("-" * len(header))
    print(f"Change Jan -> Feb: gross {gross[feb] - gross[jan]:+.2f} "
          f"({(gross[feb] - gross[jan]) / gross[jan] * 100:+.1f}%), "
          f"refunds {refund_total[feb] - refund_total[jan]:+.2f}, "
          f"net {net[feb] - net[jan]:+.2f} "
          f"({(net[feb] - net[jan]) / net[jan] * 100:+.1f}%)")

    print()
    print("PRODUCT MIX (paid orders only)")
    print("-" * len(header))
    all_pids = sorted(products)
    print(f"{'product':<10}{'price':>8}" + "".join(f"{m + ' qty':>12}" for m in MONTHS)
          + "".join(f"{m + ' rev':>12}" for m in MONTHS))
    for pid in all_pids:
        line = f"{pid:<10}{float(products[pid]['unit_price']):>8.0f}"
        for m in MONTHS:
            line += f"{mix[m][pid]:>12}"
        for m in MONTHS:
            line += f"{mix_rev[m][pid]:>12.2f}"
        print(line)

    print()
    print("REFUND DETAIL (deduplicated, attributed to paid order month)")
    print("-" * len(header))
    for row in sorted(refunds, key=lambda r: r["refund_id"]):
        orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == row["order_id"])
        print(f"{row['refund_id']:<6} order {row['order_id']:<7} "
              f"month {orig['paid_date'][:7]}  amount {float(row['amount']):>8.2f}")

    print()
    print("DATA QUALITY FINDINGS")
    print("-" * len(header))
    if dq:
        for i, d in enumerate(dq, 1):
            print(f"{i}. {d}")
    else:
        print("None.")

    # Machine-readable summary for the report
    summary = {
        "months": {
            m: {
                "paid_orders": paid_count[m],
                "cancelled_orders": cancelled_count[m],
                "gross_revenue": gross[m],
                "refunds": refund_total[m],
                "net_revenue": net[m],
                "units_by_product": dict(mix[m]),
                "revenue_by_product": dict(mix_rev[m]),
            } for m in MONTHS
        },
        "data_quality": dq,
    }
    import json
    (BASE / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    print()
    print("Wrote summary.json")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
"}

{"file_path":"/home/Liangyijia_Hu/dsh-natural-workspaces/natural-dag-20261029-v002/analysis/analyze.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reproducible reconciliation of January vs February net revenue.

Rules (from data_dictionary.md):
  * Amounts are USD.
  * Orders may contain exact repeated order_id delivery events; count each
    order_id once.
  * Only status=paid contributes quantity * products.unit_price.
  * Refunds are dollar amounts; deduplicate by refund_id and attribute each
    refund to its original paid order month.
  * Net revenue = paid gross revenue - unique refunds.
  * Product mix uses paid orders only.

Run:  python3 analyze.py
"""

import csv
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
MONTHS = ("2026-01", "2026-02")


def load_csv(name):
    with open(BASE / name, newline="") as f:
        return list(csv.DictReader(f))


def main():
    products = {r["product_id"]: r for r in load_csv("products.csv")}
    order_rows = load_csv("orders.csv")
    refund_rows = load_csv("refunds.csv")

    dq = []  # data quality findings

    # ---- Orders: deduplicate by order_id --------------------------------
    seen = {}
    dup_orders = []
    for i, row in enumerate(order_rows, start=2):  # line numbers incl. header
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid in seen:
            first = seen[oid]
            if first == row:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "exact duplicate row", i))
            else:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "CONFLICTING duplicate row", i))
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: order {oid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i}): {first[1]} vs {row}")
        else:
            seen[oid] = (i, row)

    orders = [row for _, row in seen.values()]
    if dup_orders:
        dq.append("Duplicate order rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "order_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{oid} (line {ln})" for oid, kind, ln in dup_orders))

    # ---- Refunds: deduplicate by refund_id ------------------------------
    seen_r = {}
    dup_refunds = []
    for i, row in enumerate(refund_rows, start=2):
        rid = row["refund_id"]
        if rid in seen_r:
            first = seen_r[rid]
            if first[1] == row:
                dup_refunds.append((rid, i))
            else:
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: refund {rid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i})")
        else:
            seen_r[rid] = (i, row)

    refunds = [row for _, row in seen_r.values()]
    if dup_refunds:
        dq.append("Duplicate refund rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "refund_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{rid} (line {ln})" for rid, ln in dup_refunds))

    # ---- Validation ------------------------------------------------------
    paid_orders = []
    for row in orders:
        pid = row["product_id"]
        if pid not in products:
            dq.append(f"Order {row['order_id']} references unknown product {pid}")
            continue
        if row["status"] != "paid":
            continue
        paid_orders.append(row)

    paid_ids = {r["order_id"] for r in paid_orders}
    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid not in {r["order_id"] for r in orders}:
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references unknown order {oid}")
        elif oid not in paid_ids:
            orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid)
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references non-paid order {oid} "
                      f"(status={orig['status']}); excluded from net revenue")

    # ---- Monthly aggregation --------------------------------------------
    gross = defaultdict(float)
    refund_total = defaultdict(float)
    mix = defaultdict(Counter)          # month -> product -> units
    mix_rev = defaultdict(Counter)      # month -> product -> revenue
    paid_count = Counter()
    cancelled_count = Counter()

    for row in orders:
        month = row["paid_date"][:7]
        if row["status"] == "paid":
            paid_count[month] += 1
            price = float(products[row["product_id"]]["unit_price"])
            qty = int(row["quantity"])
            rev = qty * price
            gross[month] += rev
            mix[month][row["product_id"]] += qty
            mix_rev[month][row["product_id"]] += rev
        else:
            cancelled_count[month] += 1

    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        orig = next((r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid), None)
        if orig is not None and orig["status"] == "paid":
            refund_total[orig["paid_date"][:7]] += float(row["amount"])

    # ---- Report ----------------------------------------------------------
    print("=" * 62)
    print("MONTHLY REVENUE RECONCILIATION (USD)")
    print("=" * 62)
    header = f"{'month':<10}{'paid':>6}{'cancelled':>10}{'gross':>10}{'refunds':>10}{'net':>10}"
    print(header)
    print("-" * len(header))
    net = {}
    for m in MONTHS:
        net[m] = gross[m] - refund_total[m]
        print(f"{m:<10}{paid_count[m]:>6}{cancelled_count[m]:>10}"
              f"{gross[m]:>10.2f}{refund_total[m]:>10.2f}{net[m]:>10.2f}")

    jan, feb = MONTHS
    print("-" * len(header))
    print(f"Change Jan -> Feb: gross {gross[feb] - gross[jan]:+.2f} "
          f"({(gross[feb] - gross[jan]) / gross[jan] * 100:+.1f}%), "
          f"refunds {refund_total[feb] - refund_total[jan]:+.2f}, "
          f"net {net[feb] - net[jan]:+.2f} "
          f"({(net[feb] - net[jan]) / net[jan] * 100:+.1f}%)")

    print()
    print("PRODUCT MIX (paid orders only)")
    print("-" * len(header))
    all_pids = sorted(products)
    print(f"{'product':<10}{'price':>8}" + "".join(f"{m + ' qty':>12}" for m in MONTHS)
          + "".join(f"{m + ' rev':>12}" for m in MONTHS))
    for pid in all_pids:
        line = f"{pid:<10}{float(products[pid]['unit_price']):>8.0f}"
        for m in MONTHS:
            line += f"{mix[m][pid]:>12}"
        for m in MONTHS:
            line += f"{mix_rev[m][pid]:>12.2f}"
        print(line)

    print()
    print("REFUND DETAIL (deduplicated, attributed to paid order month)")
    print("-" * len(header))
    for row in sorted(refunds, key=lambda r: r["refund_id"]):
        orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == row["order_id"])
        print(f"{row['refund_id']:<6} order {row['order_id']:<7} "
              f"month {orig['paid_date'][:7]}  amount {float(row['amount']):>8.2f}")

    print()
    print("DATA QUALITY FINDINGS")
    print("-" * len(header))
    if dq:
        for i, d in enumerate(dq, 1):
            print(f"{i}. {d}")
    else:
        print("None.")

    # Machine-readable summary for the report
    summary = {
        "months": {
            m: {
                "paid_orders": paid_count[m],
                "cancelled_orders": cancelled_count[m],
                "gross_revenue": gross[m],
                "refunds": refund_total[m],
                "net_revenue": net[m],
                "units_by_product": dict(mix[m]),
                "revenue_by_product": dict(mix_rev[m]),
            } for m in MONTHS
        },
        "data_quality": dq,
    }
    import json
    (BASE / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    print()
    print("Wrote summary.json")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
"}

{"file_path":"/home/Liangyijia_Hu/dsh-natural-workspaces/natural-dag-20261029-v002/analysis/analyze.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reproducible reconciliation of January vs February net revenue.

Rules (from data_dictionary.md):
  * Amounts are USD.
  * Orders may contain exact repeated order_id delivery events; count each
    order_id once.
  * Only status=paid contributes quantity * products.unit_price.
  * Refunds are dollar amounts; deduplicate by refund_id and attribute each
    refund to its original paid order month.
  * Net revenue = paid gross revenue - unique refunds.
  * Product mix uses paid orders only.

Run:  python3 analyze.py
"""

import csv
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
MONTHS = ("2026-01", "2026-02")


def load_csv(name):
    with open(BASE / name, newline="") as f:
        return list(csv.DictReader(f))


def main():
    products = {r["product_id"]: r for r in load_csv("products.csv")}
    order_rows = load_csv("orders.csv")
    refund_rows = load_csv("refunds.csv")

    dq = []  # data quality findings

    # ---- Orders: deduplicate by order_id --------------------------------
    seen = {}
    dup_orders = []
    for i, row in enumerate(order_rows, start=2):  # line numbers incl. header
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid in seen:
            first = seen[oid]
            if first == row:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "exact duplicate row", i))
            else:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "CONFLICTING duplicate row", i))
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: order {oid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i}): {first[1]} vs {row}")
        else:
            seen[oid] = (i, row)

    orders = [row for _, row in seen.values()]
    if dup_orders:
        dq.append("Duplicate order rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "order_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{oid} (line {ln})" for oid, kind, ln in dup_orders))

    # ---- Refunds: deduplicate by refund_id ------------------------------
    seen_r = {}
    dup_refunds = []
    for i, row in enumerate(refund_rows, start=2):
        rid = row["refund_id"]
        if rid in seen_r:
            first = seen_r[rid]
            if first[1] == row:
                dup_refunds.append((rid, i))
            else:
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: refund {rid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i})")
        else:
            seen_r[rid] = (i, row)

    refunds = [row for _, row in seen_r.values()]
    if dup_refunds:
        dq.append("Duplicate refund rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "refund_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{rid} (line {ln})" for rid, ln in dup_refunds))

    # ---- Validation ------------------------------------------------------
    paid_orders = []
    for row in orders:
        pid = row["product_id"]
        if pid not in products:
            dq.append(f"Order {row['order_id']} references unknown product {pid}")
            continue
        if row["status"] != "paid":
            continue
        paid_orders.append(row)

    paid_ids = {r["order_id"] for r in paid_orders}
    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid not in {r["order_id"] for r in orders}:
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references unknown order {oid}")
        elif oid not in paid_ids:
            orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid)
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references non-paid order {oid} "
                      f"(status={orig['status']}); excluded from net revenue")

    # ---- Monthly aggregation --------------------------------------------
    gross = defaultdict(float)
    refund_total = defaultdict(float)
    mix = defaultdict(Counter)          # month -> product -> units
    mix_rev = defaultdict(Counter)      # month -> product -> revenue
    paid_count = Counter()
    cancelled_count = Counter()

    for row in orders:
        month = row["paid_date"][:7]
        if row["status"] == "paid":
            paid_count[month] += 1
            price = float(products[row["product_id"]]["unit_price"])
            qty = int(row["quantity"])
            rev = qty * price
            gross[month] += rev
            mix[month][row["product_id"]] += qty
            mix_rev[month][row["product_id"]] += rev
        else:
            cancelled_count[month] += 1

    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        orig = next((r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid), None)
        if orig is not None and orig["status"] == "paid":
            refund_total[orig["paid_date"][:7]] += float(row["amount"])

    # ---- Report ----------------------------------------------------------
    print("=" * 62)
    print("MONTHLY REVENUE RECONCILIATION (USD)")
    print("=" * 62)
    header = f"{'month':<10}{'paid':>6}{'cancelled':>10}{'gross':>10}{'refunds':>10}{'net':>10}"
    print(header)
    print("-" * len(header))
    net = {}
    for m in MONTHS:
        net[m] = gross[m] - refund_total[m]
        print(f"{m:<10}{paid_count[m]:>6}{cancelled_count[m]:>10}"
              f"{gross[m]:>10.2f}{refund_total[m]:>10.2f}{net[m]:>10.2f}")

    jan, feb = MONTHS
    print("-" * len(header))
    print(f"Change Jan -> Feb: gross {gross[feb] - gross[jan]:+.2f} "
          f"({(gross[feb] - gross[jan]) / gross[jan] * 100:+.1f}%), "
          f"refunds {refund_total[feb] - refund_total[jan]:+.2f}, "
          f"net {net[feb] - net[jan]:+.2f} "
          f"({(net[feb] - net[jan]) / net[jan] * 100:+.1f}%)")

    print()
    print("PRODUCT MIX (paid orders only)")
    print("-" * len(header))
    all_pids = sorted(products)
    print(f"{'product':<10}{'price':>8}" + "".join(f"{m + ' qty':>12}" for m in MONTHS)
          + "".join(f"{m + ' rev':>12}" for m in MONTHS))
    for pid in all_pids:
        line = f"{pid:<10}{float(products[pid]['unit_price']):>8.0f}"
        for m in MONTHS:
            line += f"{mix[m][pid]:>12}"
        for m in MONTHS:
            line += f"{mix_rev[m][pid]:>12.2f}"
        print(line)

    print()
    print("REFUND DETAIL (deduplicated, attributed to paid order month)")
    print("-" * len(header))
    for row in sorted(refunds, key=lambda r: r["refund_id"]):
        orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == row["order_id"])
        print(f"{row['refund_id']:<6} order {row['order_id']:<7} "
              f"month {orig['paid_date'][:7]}  amount {float(row['amount']):>8.2f}")

    print()
    print("DATA QUALITY FINDINGS")
    print("-" * len(header))
    if dq:
        for i, d in enumerate(dq, 1):
            print(f"{i}. {d}")
    else:
        print("None.")

    # Machine-readable summary for the report
    summary = {
        "months": {
            m: {
                "paid_orders": paid_count[m],
                "cancelled_orders": cancelled_count[m],
                "gross_revenue": gross[m],
                "refunds": refund_total[m],
                "net_revenue": net[m],
                "units_by_product": dict(mix[m]),
                "revenue_by_product": dict(mix_rev[m]),
            } for m in MONTHS
        },
        "data_quality": dq,
    }
    import json
    (BASE / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    print()
    print("Wrote summary.json")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
"}

{"file_path":"/home/Liangyijia_Hu/dsh-natural-workspaces/natural-dag-20261029-v002/analysis/analyze.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reproducible reconciliation of January vs February net revenue.

Rules (from data_dictionary.md):
  * Amounts are USD.
  * Orders may contain exact repeated order_id delivery events; count each
    order_id once.
  * Only status=paid contributes quantity * products.unit_price.
  * Refunds are dollar amounts; deduplicate by refund_id and attribute each
    refund to its original paid order month.
  * Net revenue = paid gross revenue - unique refunds.
  * Product mix uses paid orders only.

Run:  python3 analyze.py
"""

import csv
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
MONTHS = ("2026-01", "2026-02")


def load_csv(name):
    with open(BASE / name, newline="") as f:
        return list(csv.DictReader(f))


def main():
    products = {r["product_id"]: r for r in load_csv("products.csv")}
    order_rows = load_csv("orders.csv")
    refund_rows = load_csv("refunds.csv")

    dq = []  # data quality findings

    # ---- Orders: deduplicate by order_id --------------------------------
    seen = {}
    dup_orders = []
    for i, row in enumerate(order_rows, start=2):  # line numbers incl. header
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid in seen:
            first = seen[oid]
            if first == row:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "exact duplicate row", i))
            else:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "CONFLICTING duplicate row", i))
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: order {oid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i}): {first[1]} vs {row}")
        else:
            seen[oid] = (i, row)

    orders = [row for _, row in seen.values()]
    if dup_orders:
        dq.append("Duplicate order rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "order_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{oid} (line {ln})" for oid, kind, ln in dup_orders))

    # ---- Refunds: deduplicate by refund_id ------------------------------
    seen_r = {}
    dup_refunds = []
    for i, row in enumerate(refund_rows, start=2):
        rid = row["refund_id"]
        if rid in seen_r:
            first = seen_r[rid]
            if first[1] == row:
                dup_refunds.append((rid, i))
            else:
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: refund {rid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i})")
        else:
            seen_r[rid] = (i, row)

    refunds = [row for _, row in seen_r.values()]
    if dup_refunds:
        dq.append("Duplicate refund rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "refund_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{rid} (line {ln})" for rid, ln in dup_refunds))

    # ---- Validation ------------------------------------------------------
    paid_orders = []
    for row in orders:
        pid = row["product_id"]
        if pid not in products:
            dq.append(f"Order {row['order_id']} references unknown product {pid}")
            continue
        if row["status"] != "paid":
            continue
        paid_orders.append(row)

    paid_ids = {r["order_id"] for r in paid_orders}
    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid not in {r["order_id"] for r in orders}:
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references unknown order {oid}")
        elif oid not in paid_ids:
            orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid)
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references non-paid order {oid} "
                      f"(status={orig['status']}); excluded from net revenue")

    # ---- Monthly aggregation --------------------------------------------
    gross = defaultdict(float)
    refund_total = defaultdict(float)
    mix = defaultdict(Counter)          # month -> product -> units
    mix_rev = defaultdict(Counter)      # month -> product -> revenue
    paid_count = Counter()
    cancelled_count = Counter()

    for row in orders:
        month = row["paid_date"][:7]
        if row["status"] == "paid":
            paid_count[month] += 1
            price = float(products[row["product_id"]]["unit_price"])
            qty = int(row["quantity"])
            rev = qty * price
            gross[month] += rev
            mix[month][row["product_id"]] += qty
            mix_rev[month][row["product_id"]] += rev
        else:
            cancelled_count[month] += 1

    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        orig = next((r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid), None)
        if orig is not None and orig["status"] == "paid":
            refund_total[orig["paid_date"][:7]] += float(row["amount"])

    # ---- Report ----------------------------------------------------------
    print("=" * 62)
    print("MONTHLY REVENUE RECONCILIATION (USD)")
    print("=" * 62)
    header = f"{'month':<10}{'paid':>6}{'cancelled':>10}{'gross':>10}{'refunds':>10}{'net':>10}"
    print(header)
    print("-" * len(header))
    net = {}
    for m in MONTHS:
        net[m] = gross[m] - refund_total[m]
        print(f"{m:<10}{paid_count[m]:>6}{cancelled_count[m]:>10}"
              f"{gross[m]:>10.2f}{refund_total[m]:>10.2f}{net[m]:>10.2f}")

    jan, feb = MONTHS
    print("-" * len(header))
    print(f"Change Jan -> Feb: gross {gross[feb] - gross[jan]:+.2f} "
          f"({(gross[feb] - gross[jan]) / gross[jan] * 100:+.1f}%), "
          f"refunds {refund_total[feb] - refund_total[jan]:+.2f}, "
          f"net {net[feb] - net[jan]:+.2f} "
          f"({(net[feb] - net[jan]) / net[jan] * 100:+.1f}%)")

    print()
    print("PRODUCT MIX (paid orders only)")
    print("-" * len(header))
    all_pids = sorted(products)
    print(f"{'product':<10}{'price':>8}" + "".join(f"{m + ' qty':>12}" for m in MONTHS)
          + "".join(f"{m + ' rev':>12}" for m in MONTHS))
    for pid in all_pids:
        line = f"{pid:<10}{float(products[pid]['unit_price']):>8.0f}"
        for m in MONTHS:
            line += f"{mix[m][pid]:>12}"
        for m in MONTHS:
            line += f"{mix_rev[m][pid]:>12.2f}"
        print(line)

    print()
    print("REFUND DETAIL (deduplicated, attributed to paid order month)")
    print("-" * len(header))
    for row in sorted(refunds, key=lambda r: r["refund_id"]):
        orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == row["order_id"])
        print(f"{row['refund_id']:<6} order {row['order_id']:<7} "
              f"month {orig['paid_date'][:7]}  amount {float(row['amount']):>8.2f}")

    print()
    print("DATA QUALITY FINDINGS")
    print("-" * len(header))
    if dq:
        for i, d in enumerate(dq, 1):
            print(f"{i}. {d}")
    else:
        print("None.")

    # Machine-readable summary for the report
    summary = {
        "months": {
            m: {
                "paid_orders": paid_count[m],
                "cancelled_orders": cancelled_count[m],
                "gross_revenue": gross[m],
                "refunds": refund_total[m],
                "net_revenue": net[m],
                "units_by_product": dict(mix[m]),
                "revenue_by_product": dict(mix_rev[m]),
            } for m in MONTHS
        },
        "data_quality": dq,
    }
    import json
    (BASE / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    print()
    print("Wrote summary.json")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
"}

"""Reproducible reconciliation of January vs February net revenue.

Rules (from data_dictionary.md):
  * Amounts are USD.
  * Orders may contain exact repeated order_id delivery events; count each
    order_id once.
  * Only status=paid contributes quantity * products.unit_price.
  * Refunds are dollar amounts; deduplicate by refund_id and attribute each
    refund to its original paid order month.
  * Net revenue = paid gross revenue - unique refunds.
  * Product mix uses paid orders only.

Run:  python3 analyze.py
"""

import csv
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
MONTHS = ("2026-01", "2026-02")


def load_csv(name):
    with open(BASE / name, newline="") as f:
        return list(csv.DictReader(f))


def main():
    products = {r["product_id"]: r for r in load_csv("products.csv")}
    order_rows = load_csv("orders.csv")
    refund_rows = load_csv("refunds.csv")

    dq = []  # data quality findings

    # ---- Orders: deduplicate by order_id --------------------------------
    seen = {}
    dup_orders = []
    for i, row in enumerate(order_rows, start=2):  # line numbers incl. header
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid in seen:
            first = seen[oid]
            if first == row:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "exact duplicate row", i))
            else:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "CONFLICTING duplicate row", i))
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: order {oid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i}): {first[1]} vs {row}")
        else:
            seen[oid] = (i, row)

    orders = [row for _, row in seen.values()]
    if dup_orders:
        dq.append("Duplicate order rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "order_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{oid} (line {ln})" for oid, kind, ln in dup_orders))

    # ---- Refunds: deduplicate by refund_id ------------------------------
    seen_r = {}
    dup_refunds = []
    for i, row in enumerate(refund_rows, start=2):
        rid = row["refund_id"]
        if rid in seen_r:
            first = seen_r[rid]
            if first[1] == row:
                dup_refunds.append((rid, i))
            else:
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: refund {rid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i})")
        else:
            seen_r[rid] = (i, row)

    refunds = [row for _, row in seen_r.values()]
    if dup_refunds:
        dq.append("Duplicate refund rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "refund_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{rid} (line {ln})" for rid, ln in dup_refunds))

    # ---- Validation ------------------------------------------------------
    paid_orders = []
    for row in orders:
        pid = row["product_id"]
        if pid not in products:
            dq.append(f"Order {row['order_id']} references unknown product {pid}")
            continue
        if row["status"] != "paid":
            continue
        paid_orders.append(row)

    paid_ids = {r["order_id"] for r in paid_orders}
    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid not in {r["order_id"] for r in orders}:
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references unknown order {oid}")
        elif oid not in paid_ids:
            orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid)
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references non-paid order {oid} "
                      f"(status={orig['status']}); excluded from net revenue")

    # ---- Monthly aggregation --------------------------------------------
    gross = defaultdict(float)
    refund_total = defaultdict(float)
    mix = defaultdict(Counter)          # month -> product -> units
    mix_rev = defaultdict(Counter)      # month -> product -> revenue
    paid_count = Counter()
    cancelled_count = Counter()

    for row in orders:
        month = row["paid_date"][:7]
        if row["status"] == "paid":
            paid_count[month] += 1
            price = float(products[row["product_id"]]["unit_price"])
            qty = int(row["quantity"])
            rev = qty * price
            gross[month] += rev
            mix[month][row["product_id"]] += qty
            mix_rev[month][row["product_id"]] += rev
        else:
            cancelled_count[month] += 1

    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        orig = next((r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid), None)
        if orig is not None and orig["status"] == "paid":
            refund_total[orig["paid_date"][:7]] += float(row["amount"])

    # ---- Report ----------------------------------------------------------
    print("=" * 62)
    print("MONTHLY REVENUE RECONCILIATION (USD)")
    print("=" * 62)
    header = f"{'month':<10}{'paid':>6}{'cancelled':>10}{'gross':>10}{'refunds':>10}{'net':>10}"
    print(header)
    print("-" * len(header))
    net = {}
    for m in MONTHS:
        net[m] = gross[m] - refund_total[m]
        print(f"{m:<10}{paid_count[m]:>6}{cancelled_count[m]:>10}"
              f"{gross[m]:>10.2f}{refund_total[m]:>10.2f}{net[m]:>10.2f}")

{"file_path":"/home/Liangyijia_Hu/dsh-natural-workspaces/natural-dag-20261029-v002/analysis/analyze.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reproducible reconciliation of January vs February net revenue.

Rules (from data_dictionary.md):
  * Amounts are USD.
  * Orders may contain exact repeated order_id delivery events; count each
    order_id once.
  * Only status=paid contributes quantity * products.unit_price.
  * Refunds are dollar amounts; deduplicate by refund_id and attribute each
    refund to its original paid order month.
  * Net revenue = paid gross revenue - unique refunds.
  * Product mix uses paid orders only.

Run:  python3 analyze.py
"""

import csv
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
MONTHS = ("2026-01", "2026-02")


def load_csv(name):
    with open(BASE / name, newline="") as f:
        return list(csv.DictReader(f))


def main():
    products = {r["product_id"]: r for r in load_csv("products.csv")}
    order_rows = load_csv("orders.csv")
    refund_rows = load_csv("refunds.csv")

    dq = []  # data quality findings

    # ---- Orders: deduplicate by order_id --------------------------------
    seen = {}
    dup_orders = []
    for i, row in enumerate(order_rows, start=2):  # line numbers incl. header
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid in seen:
            first = seen[oid]
            if first == row:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "exact duplicate row", i))
            else:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "CONFLICTING duplicate row", i))
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: order {oid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i}): {first[1]} vs {row}")
        else:
            seen[oid] = (i, row)

    orders = [row for _, row in seen.values()]
    if dup_orders:
        dq.append("Duplicate order rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "order_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{oid} (line {ln})" for oid, kind, ln in dup_orders))

    # ---- Refunds: deduplicate by refund_id ------------------------------
    seen_r = {}
    dup_refunds = []
    for i, row in enumerate(refund_rows, start=2):
        rid = row["refund_id"]
        if rid in seen_r:
            first = seen_r[rid]
            if first[1] == row:
                dup_refunds.append((rid, i))
            else:
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: refund {rid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i})")
        else:
            seen_r[rid] = (i, row)

    refunds = [row for _, row in seen_r.values()]
    if dup_refunds:
        dq.append("Duplicate refund rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "refund_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{rid} (line {ln})" for rid, ln in dup_refunds))

    # ---- Validation ------------------------------------------------------
    paid_orders = []
    for row in orders:
        pid = row["product_id"]
        if pid not in products:
            dq.append(f"Order {row['order_id']} references unknown product {pid}")
            continue
        if row["status"] != "paid":
            continue
        paid_orders.append(row)

    paid_ids = {r["order_id"] for r in paid_orders}
    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid not in {r["order_id"] for r in orders}:
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references unknown order {oid}")
        elif oid not in paid_ids:
            orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid)
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references non-paid order {oid} "
                      f"(status={orig['status']}); excluded from net revenue")

    # ---- Monthly aggregation --------------------------------------------
    gross = defaultdict(float)
    refund_total = defaultdict(float)
    mix = defaultdict(Counter)          # month -> product -> units
    mix_rev = defaultdict(Counter)      # month -> product -> revenue
    paid_count = Counter()
    cancelled_count = Counter()

    for row in orders:
        month = row["paid_date"][:7]
        if row["status"] == "paid":
            paid_count[month] += 1
            price = float(products[row["product_id"]]["unit_price"])
            qty = int(row["quantity"])
            rev = qty * price
            gross[month] += rev
            mix[month][row["product_id"]] += qty
            mix_rev[month][row["product_id"]] += rev
        else:
            cancelled_count[month] += 1

    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        orig = next((r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid), None)
        if orig is not None and orig["status"] == "paid":
            refund_total[orig["paid_date"][:7]] += float(row["amount"])

    # ---- Report ----------------------------------------------------------
    print("=" * 62)
    print("MONTHLY REVENUE RECONCILIATION (USD)")
    print("=" * 62)
    header = f"{'month':<10}{'paid':>6}{'cancelled':>10}{'gross':>10}{'refunds':>10}{'net':>10}"
    print(header)
    print("-" * len(header))
    net = {}
    for m in MONTHS:
        net[m] = gross[m] - refund_total[m]
        print(f"{m:<10}{paid_count[m]:>6}{cancelled_count[m]:>10}"
              f"{gross[m]:>10.2f}{refund_total[m]:>10.2f}{net[m]:>10.2f}")

    jan, feb = MONTHS
    print("-" * len(header))
    print(f"Change Jan -> Feb: gross {gross[feb] - gross[jan]:+.2f} "
          f"({(gross[feb] - gross[jan]) / gross[jan] * 100:+.1f}%), "
          f"refunds {refund_total[feb] - refund_total[jan]:+.2f}, "
          f"net {net[feb] - net[jan]:+.2f} "
          f"({(net[feb] - net[jan]) / net[jan] * 100:+.1f}%)")

    print()
    print("PRODUCT MIX (paid orders only)")
    print("-" * len(header))
    all_pids = sorted(products)
    print(f"{'product':<10}{'price':>8}" + "".join(f"{m + ' qty':>12}" for m in MONTHS)
          + "".join(f"{m + ' rev':>12}" for m in MONTHS))
    for pid in all_pids:
        line = f"{pid:<10}{float(products[pid]['unit_price']):>8.0f}"
        for m in MONTHS:
            line += f"{mix[m][pid]:>12}"
        for m in MONTHS:
            line += f"{mix_rev[m][pid]:>12.2f}"
        print(line)

    print()
    print("REFUND DETAIL (deduplicated, attributed to paid order month)")
    print("-" * len(header))
    for row in sorted(refunds, key=lambda r: r["refund_id"]):
        orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == row["order_id"])
        print(f"{row['refund_id']:<6} order {row['order_id']:<7} "
              f"month {orig['paid_date'][:7]}  amount {float(row['amount']):>8.2f}")

    print()
    print("DATA QUALITY FINDINGS")
    print("-" * len(header))
    if dq:
        for i, d in enumerate(dq, 1):
            print(f"{i}. {d}")
    else:
        print("None.")

    # Machine-readable summary for the report
    summary = {
        "months": {
            m: {
                "paid_orders": paid_count[m],
                "cancelled_orders": cancelled_count[m],
                "gross_revenue": gross[m],
                "refunds": refund_total[m],
                "net_revenue": net[m],
                "units_by_product": dict(mix[m]),
                "revenue_by_product": dict(mix_rev[m]),
            } for m in MONTHS
        },
        "data_quality": dq,
    }
    import json
    (BASE / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    print()
    print("Wrote summary.json")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
"}

{"file_path":"/home/Liangyijia_Hu/dsh-natural-workspaces/natural-dag-20261029-v002/analysis/analyze.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reproducible reconciliation of January vs February net revenue.

Rules (from data_dictionary.md):
  * Amounts are USD.
  * Orders may contain exact repeated order_id delivery events; count each
    order_id once.
  * Only status=paid contributes quantity * products.unit_price.
  * Refunds are dollar amounts; deduplicate by refund_id and attribute each
    refund to its original paid order month.
  * Net revenue = paid gross revenue - unique refunds.
  * Product mix uses paid orders only.

Run:  python3 analyze.py
"""

import csv
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
MONTHS = ("2026-01", "2026-02")


def load_csv(name):
    with open(BASE / name, newline="") as f:
        return list(csv.DictReader(f))


def main():
    products = {r["product_id"]: r for r in load_csv("products.csv")}
    order_rows = load_csv("orders.csv")
    refund_rows = load_csv("refunds.csv")

    dq = []  # data quality findings

    # ---- Orders: deduplicate by order_id --------------------------------
    seen = {}
    dup_orders = []
    for i, row in enumerate(order_rows, start=2):  # line numbers incl. header
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid in seen:
            first = seen[oid]
            if first == row:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "exact duplicate row", i))
            else:
                dup_orders.append((oid, "CONFLICTING duplicate row", i))
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: order {oid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i}): {first[1]} vs {row}")
        else:
            seen[oid] = (i, row)

    orders = [row for _, row in seen.values()]
    if dup_orders:
        dq.append("Duplicate order rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "order_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{oid} (line {ln})" for oid, kind, ln in dup_orders))

    # ---- Refunds: deduplicate by refund_id ------------------------------
    seen_r = {}
    dup_refunds = []
    for i, row in enumerate(refund_rows, start=2):
        rid = row["refund_id"]
        if rid in seen_r:
            first = seen_r[rid]
            if first[1] == row:
                dup_refunds.append((rid, i))
            else:
                dq.append(f"CONFLICT: refund {rid} has differing duplicate rows "
                          f"(line {first[0]} vs line {i})")
        else:
            seen_r[rid] = (i, row)

    refunds = [row for _, row in seen_r.values()]
    if dup_refunds:
        dq.append("Duplicate refund rows (exact repeats, counted once per "
                  "refund_id per data dictionary): "
                  + ", ".join(f"{rid} (line {ln})" for rid, ln in dup_refunds))

    # ---- Validation ------------------------------------------------------
    paid_orders = []
    for row in orders:
        pid = row["product_id"]
        if pid not in products:
            dq.append(f"Order {row['order_id']} references unknown product {pid}")
            continue
        if row["status"] != "paid":
            continue
        paid_orders.append(row)

    paid_ids = {r["order_id"] for r in paid_orders}
    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        if oid not in {r["order_id"] for r in orders}:
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references unknown order {oid}")
        elif oid not in paid_ids:
            orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid)
            dq.append(f"Refund {row['refund_id']} references non-paid order {oid} "
                      f"(status={orig['status']}); excluded from net revenue")

    # ---- Monthly aggregation --------------------------------------------
    gross = defaultdict(float)
    refund_total = defaultdict(float)
    mix = defaultdict(Counter)          # month -> product -> units
    mix_rev = defaultdict(Counter)      # month -> product -> revenue
    paid_count = Counter()
    cancelled_count = Counter()

    for row in orders:
        month = row["paid_date"][:7]
        if row["status"] == "paid":
            paid_count[month] += 1
            price = float(products[row["product_id"]]["unit_price"])
            qty = int(row["quantity"])
            rev = qty * price
            gross[month] += rev
            mix[month][row["product_id"]] += qty
            mix_rev[month][row["product_id"]] += rev
        else:
            cancelled_count[month] += 1

    for row in refunds:
        oid = row["order_id"]
        orig = next((r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == oid), None)
        if orig is not None and orig["status"] == "paid":
            refund_total[orig["paid_date"][:7]] += float(row["amount"])

    # ---- Report ----------------------------------------------------------
    print("=" * 62)
    print("MONTHLY REVENUE RECONCILIATION (USD)")
    print("=" * 62)
    header = f"{'month':<10}{'paid':>6}{'cancelled':>10}{'gross':>10}{'refunds':>10}{'net':>10}"
    print(header)
    print("-" * len(header))
    net = {}
    for m in MONTHS:
        net[m] = gross[m] - refund_total[m]
        print(f"{m:<10}{paid_count[m]:>6}{cancelled_count[m]:>10}"
              f"{gross[m]:>10.2f}{refund_total[m]:>10.2f}{net[m]:>10.2f}")

    jan, feb = MONTHS
    print("-" * len(header))
    print(f"Change Jan -> Feb: gross {gross[feb] - gross[jan]:+.2f} "
          f"({(gross[feb] - gross[jan]) / gross[jan] * 100:+.1f}%), "
          f"refunds {refund_total[feb] - refund_total[jan]:+.2f}, "
          f"net {net[feb] - net[jan]:+.2f} "
          f"({(net[feb] - net[jan]) / net[jan] * 100:+.1f}%)")

    print()
    print("PRODUCT MIX (paid orders only)")
    print("-" * len(header))
    all_pids = sorted(products)
    print(f"{'product':<10}{'price':>8}" + "".join(f"{m + ' qty':>12}" for m in MONTHS)
          + "".join(f"{m + ' rev':>12}" for m in MONTHS))
    for pid in all_pids:
        line = f"{pid:<10}{float(products[pid]['unit_price']):>8.0f}"
        for m in MONTHS:
            line += f"{mix[m][pid]:>12}"
        for m in MONTHS:
            line += f"{mix_rev[m][pid]:>12.2f}"
        print(line)

    print()
    print("REFUND DETAIL (deduplicated, attributed to paid order month)")
    print("-" * len(header))
    for row in sorted(refunds, key=lambda r: r["refund_id"]):
        orig = next(r for r in orders if r["order_id"] == row["order_id"])
        print(f"{row['refund_id']:<6} order {row['order_id']:<7} "
              f"month {orig['paid_date'][:7]}  amount {float(row['amount']):>8.2f}")

    print()
    print("DATA QUALITY FINDINGS")
    print("-" * len(header))
    if dq:
        for i, d in enumerate(dq, 1):
            print(f"{i}. {d}")
    else:
        print("None.")

    # Machine-readable summary for the report
    summary = {
        "months": {
            m: {
                "paid_orders": paid_count[m],
                "cancelled_orders": cancelled_count[m],
                "gross_revenue": gross[m],
                "refunds": refund_total[m],
                "net_revenue": net[m],
                "units_by_product": dict(mix[m]),
                "revenue_by_product": dict(mix_rev[m]),
            } for m in MONTHS
        },
        "data_quality": dq,
    }
    import json
    (BASE / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    print()
    print("Wrote summary.json")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
"}
